keyEvents.text: Goal! AZ 0, Juventus 1. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Randal Kolo Muani with a cross following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Lewis Schouten (AZ).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, AZ. Wesley Hoedt replaces Lewis Schouten because of an injury.
Wesley Hoedt (AZ) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! AZ 0, Juventus 2. Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Nick Woltemade.
Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Juventus. Jérémie Boga replaces Kerim Alajbegovic.
Substitution, Juventus. Juan Cabal replaces Andrea Cambiaso.
Substitution, AZ. Kees Smit replaces Valdemar Byskov.
Substitution, AZ. Elijah Dijkstra replaces Denso Kasius.
Substitution, AZ. Jordy Clasie replaces Wouter Goes.
Substitution, AZ. Ayoub Oufkir replaces Calvin Stengs.
Substitution, Juventus. Jeff Ekhator replaces Nick Woltemade.
Substitution, Juventus. Bremer replaces Federico Gatti.
Jeff Ekhator (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Juventus. Douglas Luiz replaces Randal Kolo Muani.
Goal! AZ 1, Juventus 2. Mexx Meerdink (AZ) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Elijah Dijkstra.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Delay in match because of an injury Guglielmo Vicario (Juventus).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Juan Cabal (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
